changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Lexaria Bioscience warrant inducement/exercise financing (Sept 2026) (interest 4, risk 6)

thesis.text: Lexaria is a microcap pharmaceutical (DehydraTECH platform) that continues to rely on equity/warrant financings to fund operations; this warrant inducement exchange (new Series A/B warrants at $12.67 strike) signals ongoing need for capital and potential further dilution. Until proceeds, share count post-exercise, and use of funds are disclosed, this remains a financing-risk event rather than a fundamental catalyst; monitor subsequent 8-Ks/10-Qs for cash runway and dilution impact.
